Wings for Marie - by Tool

Written as a eulogy for the mother of the band's lead singer. Judith Marie died very roughly 10,000 days (27 years) after suffering a cerebral aneurysm which left her paralyzed for the remainder of her life. She's described as a very devout southern baptist who lived her life by the book for the church. Despite being "cursed" as her son saw things, she believed she had received a blessing that would enable her to better serve the lord. Maynard, the lead singer, despite being deeply spiritual grew a hatred for organized religion, a mindset which strained his relationship with his mother and forms the bulk of the second half of the song. This song takes us inside of the mind of a grieving son hurt, disappointed, and disgusted as he contemplates his mother's life while trying to come to peace with her passing.
